sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: H EARING impairment affects almost 10% of individuals in the industrialized world [1]. Individuals with profound deafness are in need of cochlear implants to listen to everyday sounds. sections.text_preview: For obvious reasons, rejection of power-supply noise is a major design constraint for low-noise systems.
